verdict.rationale: Superhuman offers adjacent team-collaboration features: @mentioning teammates in team comments, shared read statuses, and reply indicators that prevent duplicate work. It also routes incoming mail into categories via AI Auto Labels and split-inbox tabs. None of this amounts to explicitly assigning a conversation's ownership to a teammate, and the routing sorts mail within one user's own inbox rather than sending it to a teammate. Missing for 10: an explicit conversation assignment/owner feature, rules that route incoming mail to specific teammates, any shared-inbox ownership model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
